question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Call it a day

options.text: The time at the end of the day

solution:
The correct answer is: **'****Stop working on something****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Call it a day"** means to stop working on something, usually because you think you have done enough or because the workday is over. (काम समाप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example:** After working for 10 hours straight, we decided to **call it a day** and go home.
 
 
 
• **"Stop working on something"** is the correct meaning of the idiom "**Call it a day**." (किसी काम को बंद करना)
 
 
• **Example:** It's getting late; let's **call it a day**.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Start working on something** (किसी काम को शुरू करना):

 
 
• **Example:** We should start working on the new project tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **The time at the end of the day** (दिन के अंत का समय):
 
 
• **Example:** The time at the end of the day is when I usually relax.
 
 
 
• **Start a day badly** (दिन की खराब शुरुआत करना):
 
 
• **Example:** She started her day badly by spilling coffee on her dress.
